name: kinetic-type-ring
title: Kinetic Type Ring
description: A phrase wrapped once around a ring in real 3D. A falling dot pulls the letters out of a blur, then drag or scroll spins the ring.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/kinetic-type-ring
The type size is solved from the stage, so the phrase wraps the ring exactly once at any width. Give the section its own height with `className` when the default clamp does not suit the page.
